name: ANIL X Frontier Control Plane
purpose: Keep model/tool routing capability-first, health-aware, evidence-first and automatically refreshed from authoritative provider metadata.
principles: Prefer live runtime evidence over labels or benchmark claims.
Route by task, capability, latency, reliability and cost when measurable.
A new model is not production-ready until a runtime smoke test passes.
Do not silently weaken security, payment or wallet approval boundaries.

refresh.source: official provider model APIs when credentials are available

selection.tieBreak: lowest observed failure/latency cost after capability requirements are satisfied
